the Bomb in combat?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
K.P. Petker wrote:
>
> If a minions equipped with a Bomb uses the Bomb's directed action to burn
> a location and this action is blocked, is the minion still able to use
> the Bomb in combat?

Yes. The bomb isn't burned until it is actually used.
So, it isn't burned if the action (to burn a location) is blocked.
And it isn't burned if the strike (for 5R) never resolves (i.e.,
combat is ended prematurely via S:CE or Rotschreck).
